summary: Empty story: children is [] and no workitems/ exists on disk, so it must be expanded before acceptance (root plan.md line 36 confirms ST-07/ST-08 are unexpanded expansion tasks). The specification itself is sound: four well-formed criteria (AC-bal-timing, AC-bal-perf, AC-bal-flow, AC-bal-scarcity), a correct dependency on ST-06 with no ancestor/descendant cycles, an honest scope inventory, and a handoff that names the exact sections and existing harnesses. Findings: (1) no decomposition exists, so no children preserve the parent criteria and no final proof owner is assigned; (2) AC-bal-timing bundles two behaviors (telemetry recording vs numerical tuning toward 90-120 min / expert 55-75 min) that should land in separate children; (3) the scope inventory lists five work areas (telemetry s71, difficulty curve s39, scarcity s40, density s49, performance s34) that exceed any leaf limit and need splitting. Useful split boundary per the story's own hint: (a) section 71 telemetry/debug instrumentation with headless-compatible exports from src/util/debug.ts; (b) full instrumented playthroughs plus numerical tuning (oxygen, currents, pressure gates, 130-170 percent scarcity via simulateCriticalPath plus physical route scenarios, 20-60 second density) owning the AC-bal-timing tuning proof and AC-bal-scarcity; (c) 60 FPS at 1080p verification and fix-forward in the largest encounter and each band's representative scene owning AC-bal-perf, with discoveries routed to fix planning rather than in-place redesign. Every child must carry the assigned parent criteria verbatim with one named final proof owner per shared criterion, and the 90-120 minute claim must rest on recorded playtest evidence, not headless math.
